  • Comfort thriving in a fast-paced, early-stage environment with high ambiguity and rapid change.

Strong advantages:

  • Experience with time-series forecasting and/or linear optimisation.

  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, React, Python; exposure to FastAPI, TypeScript, or Supabase is a plus.

  • Background as a CTO, founding engineer, or startup founder.

  • Corporate background (e.g. industrials, energy, consulting) paired with a demonstrated startup mindset and grit.

  • Curiosity for energy markets, industrial technology, or data-intensive B2B applications.

Location

This role is based in Munich, Germany. You'll work on-site the majority of the week, with flexibility for occasional remote days. Fully remote arrangements are not available for this position.

Compensation & Benefits

jobs.title: International Expansion
jobs.description:
Your Impact

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

That's where you come in. You take one new European market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows the market from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards.

 

Your Tasks

  • Open up a new European market end to end: sharpen the ICP, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

 

Your Profile

  • Customer-facing experience and first go-to-market exposure: you've sold to or worked closely with customers before, you're at home in the room with them, and you understand how B2B sales works

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • You grasp complex products

  • and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English; additional European languages are a plus. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • Willingness to travel within your target markets


Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your country: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the region.


Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Senior MRI Application Specialist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As a Senior MRI Application Specialist, you play a key role in driving our innovation initiatives by assisting in building new applications of our AI-powered MRI technology.

You contribute to laying the groundwork for our advancements by identifying and documenting biomarkers that provide our customers with the answers they seek. In addition, you will be managing and performing data acquisition for our cutting-edge MRI imaging systems. You will be working with an interdisciplinary innovation team, primarily collaborating with MRI scientists, data scientists, and data platform specialists to drive cutting-edge solutions. You will help define new applications working together with the customer, organize logistics, support test runs in-house and on customer sites, and ensure the smooth operation of our unique MRI technologies, as well as actively participate in development of new applications.

With strong attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement, you will be integral to our mission of unleashing AI-powered imaging for everyone and everything, helping us push the boundaries of what's possible in imaging.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Build biomarker expertise to further application development within a multidisciplinary team, working closely with members from diverse fields to achieve shared goals.

  • Manage data acquisition for applications, strongly optimizing and automating trial processes to help scale data acquisition and improve operational efficiency.

  • Ensure accurate and consistent capture of unique data points, optimizing data integrity and workflow.

  • Monitor and track system performance by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple resources using scientific methods.

  • Review and annotate MRI scans, following established protocols to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and quality of images and annotation results.

  • Travel frequently (up to 40%) to customer sites for extended periods of time to provide on-site support, gather customer needs, work with the customer and their samples. All to translate this into hypotheses and biomarker definitions.

  • Ensure accurate traceability throughout the project lifecycle by documenting all processes, data, and materials from inception to completion.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Apply a data-driven approach, utilizing rigorous experimental research methods to gather evidence and ensure high-quality results.

  • Demonstrate strong attention to detail, combining precision and excellent hand-eye coordination to carefully handle and examine test samples.

  • Willingness and ability to travel to various customer sites across Europe, and you possess a valid driver’s license.

  • You speak one or multiple of the following languages: Spanish, Italian, French or Greek.

  • Excellent communication skills are essential, as you’ll be collaborating across teams, sharing insights, and presenting ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders including customers.

What Makes You Stand Out

Technical expertise

  • You possess strong proficiency in data management tools, including Google Sheets and Excel, to efficiently organize, analyze, and manage data.

  • You have experience in the food industry, with a focus or interest in fresh produce.

Behavioural competencies

  • You embrace innovative approaches, continuously seeking the most effective solutions through exploration and adaptability.

  • You exhibit a patient, focused, and detail-oriented working style, driven by a passion for precision and thoroughness.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, iterating quickly to integrate the latest knowledge and developments.

  • You enjoy traveling and adapting to diverse work environments, bringing flexibility and a dynamic mindset to your role.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

  • Du verfügst über tiefgehende Expertise in allen SEO-Disziplinen: Technical SEO, On-Page, Content-Strategie und Offpage/Linkbuilding – und weißt, wie du diese strategisch miteinander verzahnst.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen SEO-Tools wie Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Sistrix, Google Analytics, Audisto oder Screaming Frog.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Developer-Teams und bringst ein solides technisches Verständnis mit (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs).

  • Du kennst dich mit KI-basiertem Arbeiten und GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) aus und hast bereits Erfahrung mit der Optimierung für KI-gestützte Suchmaschinen, LLMs und AI-Overviews gesammelt.

  • Du arbeitest unternehmerisch, denkst analytisch, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und richtest dein Handeln konsequent an messbarem Impact aus.

  • Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke, strukturierte und proaktive Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität und fließenden Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen.

jobs.title: Technical Founder's Associate (Berlin, on-site)
jobs.description:
sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

Join us and play a pivotal role in transforming the automation landscape in heavy industries.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on Founder's Associate to work directly with our founders in Berlin. This role suits a recent graduate who combines quantitative and economic thinking with real technical ability – the kind of person who can size a market in the morning, pull the numbers themselves in the afternoon, and spend the next day in the workshop or on-site getting hardware onto a machine. A meaningful part of this job is physical: moving machines, equipment, and hardware. You will do the work rather than coordinate it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own high-priority projects end to end on behalf of the founders, from customer pilots and field deployments to internal tooling and process automation.

  • Get hands-on with hardware – preparing and assembling sensor and compute kits, moving machines and equipment, and supporting installation, testing, and demos on-site.

  • Build the analysis behind key decisions – unit economics, pricing, market sizing, and machine performance data – pulling and cleaning the data yourself.

  • Prepare material for investors, grant programmes, and customers, and work across engineering, commercial, and operations teams to unblock execution.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field – a combination of the above is ideal.

  • Able to ship working software with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor – scripts, prototypes, and automations – with enough Python and SQL to review, debug, and trust what comes out.

  • Valid category B driving licence, and the willingness to drive to customer sites, transport equipment, and move machines and hardware.

  • Evidence of getting things done without supervision – a startup, a side project, a student venture, or a demanding internship.

  • Based in Berlin (or willing to relocate), happy to work on-site, and comfortable spending time in a workshop and around heavy machinery in operation.

Preferred Skills:

  • Practical workshop experience – wiring, mechanical assembly, prototyping, or vehicle work, whether from a robotics team, Formula Student, or personal projects.

  • Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, machine learning, or industrial hardware.

  • Experience operating vans, trailers, forklifts, or heavy equipment, or a willingness to be trained.

  • Practical experience building internal tools, dashboards, or automations with modern AI tooling.

  • Working knowledge of German, and interest in customers in mining, construction, or heavy industry.

What We Offer:

  • Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery – making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task

  • Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors

  • Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment

  • Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead

  • Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment


Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation package and stock options.

  • Beverages on-site and regular social events.

  • Engage with top-tier researchers, engineers, and thought leaders.

  • Influence the future of robotic technologies and tackle significant technological challenges.

  • Assistance with relocation to Berlin.


About Us:

Heavy machinery, light years ahead.

sensmore automates the world's largest machines with unprecedented intelligence. Our proprietary Physical AI enables heavy machines such as wheel loaders to instantly adapt to dynamic environments and execute new tasks without prior training.

We integrate cutting-edge robotics into a platform powering intelligence and automation products - transforming productivity and safety for customers in mining, construction, and adjacent industries today.

We are proudly backed by Point Nine and other Tier 1 investors.

jobs.title: Senior Konzepter:in (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen am Standort München oder Berlin eine:n Senior Konzepter:in (w/m/d) zur Unterstützung unseres Creative-Teams. Die Rolle ist zunächst auf 18 Monate befristet.

Wir sind eine globale, socially-led Creative Agency mit über 1.300 Mitarbeitenden in 17 Büros weltweit. In einer Welt, in der Social Media Kultur prägt, helfen wir Marken dabei, Ideen zu entwickeln, über die Menschen sprechen.

Wir verstehen Online-Communities, Kulturen und Subkulturen über die gesamte Social Landscape hinweg. Zu unseren Kund:innen in Deutschland zählen unter anderem AUDI AG, Mercedes-Benz Trucks und Müller. We Are Social ist Teil der Plus Company.

Requirements

Was beinhaltet die Rolle?

  • Entwicklung von Social-first Konzepten, Content-Ideen und kreativen Kampagnen – vom Briefing und ersten Gedanken bis zur ausgearbeiteten Idee
  • Entwicklung von starken Copies, Headlines und Storytelling-Ansätzen auf Deutsch und Englisch
  • Konzeption und Entwicklung von kanalspezifischem, innovativem Content für Plattformen wie Instagram, TikTok, Entwicklung kreativer Ideen für unterschiedliche Kund:innen und Branchen – von Premium Beauty & Cosmetics bis Finance
  • Erstellung und Präsentation kreativer Konzepte und Ideen für unsere Kund:innen
  • Redaktionelle Überarbeitung und Qualitätssicherung von Konzepten, Ideen, Content und Copies
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit in multidisziplinären Teams mit Account, Social Media, Strategy, Research & Insights, Design und Paid Media
  • Kommunikation und kreative Abstimmung mit Kund:innen sowie externen Partner
  • Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Content Production sowie kreative Begleitung und Supervision von Shootings und Drehs
  • Beobachtung von Social Trends, Plattformen und Cultural Movements und Übersetzung in relevante Ideen für unsere Kund:innen

Wonach suchen wir?

  • min 2 Jahre Erfahrung in Konzeption und Kreation, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld mit Schwerpunkt Social Media oder digitale Kommunikation
  • Ein starkes Verständnis dafür, wie Ideen auf Social funktionieren – von Always-on Content bis hin zu größeren Kampagnen
  • Leidenschaft für Ideation, Storytelling, Sprache und starke kreative Konzepte
  • Sehr gutes Gespür für Social Media, Pop Culture, Trends und aktuelle Cultural Movements
  • Freude daran, gemeinsam im Team Ideen weiterzuentwickeln und kreative Lösungen zu finden
  • Sicherheit darin, eigene Ideen und Konzepte intern sowie gegenüber Kund:innen zu präsentieren und zu vertreten
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und gleichzeitig kollaborative Arbeitsweise
  • Engagement, Kreativität und Hands-on-Mentalität

Benefits

Warum du Teil unseres Teams werden solltest?

Lebendiger Teamgeist: Wir tragen das Adjektiv social sehr bewusst im Namen und leben einen starken Teamgeist und eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, in denen deine Stimme zählt!

Spannende Projekte mit internationaler Reichweite: Wir arbeiten an digitalen Projekten, die Maßstäbe setzen! Unsere Kund:innen kommen aus dem B2C- und B2B-Umfeld und sind sowohl lokale als auch internationale Player.

Global verbunden und lokal verwurzelt: Unsere Teams an den Standorten München und Kreuzberg profitieren von einem nachhaltigen Wissensaustausch mit den WAS Standorten weltweit und sind im Glockenbachviertel und Kreuzberg zu Hause.

Flexibilität - Yes please!: Hybrides Arbeiten vereint für uns die Vorteile des Home Offices mit denen des Arbeitens im Büro. Genau deswegen haben wir uns für einen 2/3 Split entschieden, der bedeutet, dass wir bei 40h mindestens 2 Tage vor Ort mit unseren Kolleg:innen und 3 Tage im Home Office arbeiten. But that’s not all! Darüber hinaus sind wir große Fans von Remote Arbeit. Deswegen hast du bei uns die Möglichkeit 20 Tage innerhalb Deutschlands und weitere 20 Tage innerhalb Europas remote zu arbeiten. Wenn du also kein großer Fan des Deutschen Winters bist, join us und du kannst diese Zeit in Portugal oder Griechenland genießen.    

Mehr Benefits für dich: Weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Well-being ist und wir Benefits einfach lieben, bieten wir dir mehr als nur den Standard. Genieße 2 zusätzliche Health Days, Menstrual Leave, einen freien Tag an deinem Geburtstag, eine Kooperation mit Wellpass, das Deutschlandticket, eine Mitgliedschaft bei OpenUp und vieles mehr.

jobs.title: (Senior) Account Manager
jobs.description:
Your Impact

We're strong at landing new customers. Now we need to get excellent at growing them.

Expanding within the customer base is one of Tacto's biggest growth levers, and we're building it out for the long term. Most mature B2B companies generate 50%+ of their revenue from existing customers - we want to capture more of that potential, and we're strengthening the team to get there. As Account Manager, you'll be a driving force behind our expansion motion: identifying and closing upsells, cross-sells, and strategic price increases across our customer base, and helping build and sharpen the playbook as we scale it. You'll work between Sales, Customer Value, and Product, spotting growth opportunities and turning them into revenue. This is your chance to build and grow a crucial commercial function at one of Europe's fastest growing industrial AI companies.

Your Tasks

  • Own deals end-to-end: Identify opportunities, build business cases, run negotiations, close deals. Manage contracts and pricing logic.

  • Master account intelligence: Read customer dynamics, map stakeholders, understand politics. Know when to drive expansion yourself vs. when to bring in AEs or Customer Value. Identify perfect timing for upsells.

  • Coordinate across functions: Coordinate with Sales (pipeline), Customer Success (value-delivery), Product (what to sell), and Finance (forecasting) to drive expansion deals

  • Own forecasting and planning: Build accurate expansion forecasts. Coordinate deal timelines. Keep the business informed and on track.

  • Translate roadmap into revenue: Work with Product and Marketing to turn new modules into concrete expansion conversations with the right customers at the right time.

  • Help building the function as it scales: Turn what you learn into reusable process, qualification criteria, pricing guardrails, forecasting templates, rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value. Where the playbook doesn't exist yet, you help writing it

Your Profile

We're looking for someone who can build, close, and scale. Here's what typically works:

  • 2-4 years in high-performance environments: A proven track record of hitting, and significantly overachieving, quarterly or yearly commercial targets, in account management, sales, or a customer success role with a real commercial component.

  • Proven commercial track record in B2B SaaS companies.

  • Extremely smart and driven – you connect dots quickly, learn fast, and push hard to win

  • Excellent stakeholder management – you navigate complex organizations, build relationships with senior buyers (Heads of Procurement, C-Level), and align internal teams

  • Negotiation toughness – you hold your ground in price discussions without burning bridges

  • Process-oriented – you own details: contracts, terms, renewal dates, forecasting

  • Genuine interest in industrial procurement – you want to understand how manufacturing companies work and speak their language

  • Native German + fluent English

Why This Role is Awesome

This is the first dedicated Account Manager seat at Tacto. Some first structures exist, but most of the function is still yours to build: the quota model, the rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Value, the process itself. Get this right, and expansion becomes Tacto's biggest new revenue lever within two to three years, that's the scale of upside on the table. Do it well for the first 12 to 18 months, and you define your next step: a bigger book of accounts, leading the function as it grows into a full team, or a move into Sales or Customer Value leadership.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

  • This is not customer support with a sales quota bolted on. You'll be measured on revenue, not on being liked, and some weeks that means pushing a commercial conversation the customer wasn't asking for.

  • This is not a mature, handed-to-you playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, your own forecast discipline, and parts of the process itself.

  • Prove you can turn module adoption into signed expansion revenue, and we'll back you owning a bigger book, leading the function, or moving into Sales or CV leadership next.

Why Tacto

  • We bet on young talent and mean it. We consistently back smart, hungry, young people with real ownership early. The large majority of our Leadership Team was promoted internally, you deliver impact and the sky is the limit at Tacto.

  • Backed to win big. We're Sequoia and Index Ventures-funded, with more than €50M raised. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Get a glimpse here: https://luma.com/tacto

  • You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

In deiner Rolle fokussierst du dich auf:

  • Aufsichtsrecht. Du berätst unsere Fachbereiche eigenständig in allen aufsichtsrechtlichen Fragestellungen (WpIG, WpHG, KAGB, MaRisk, MaComp, GwG, DORA) und entwickelst unser Internes Kontroll- und Compliance-Management-System in der täglichen Anwendung weiter.
  • Erste Adresse im Haus. Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für Portfolio Management, Investment Operations, Sales, Marketing und HR und gibst pragmatische Handlungsempfehlungen statt Gutachten mit offenem Ausgang.
  • Prüfungen & Behördenkontakt. Du koordinierst in- und externe Prüfungen, führst die Kommunikation mit BaFin sowie Bundesbank und steuerst externe Kanzleien und Berater dort, wo wir spezialisierte Unterstützung brauchen.
  • Regulatorische Funktionen. Du übernimmst regulatorische Mandate, insbesondere die Rolle des stellvertretenden Geldwäschebeauftragten (Deputy MLRO) und des Datenschutzbeauftragten.
  • Neue Produkte & strategische Projekte. Du begleitest die Auflage neuer Fonds mit Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften und Depotbanken sowie unsere internationale Expansion rechtlich von der Struktur bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Verträge, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht. Du verantwortest das Vertragswesen und berätst in den weiteren Rechtsgebieten, die ein wachsender Asset Manager täglich berührt.


Deine Erfahrung

  • Zwei juristische Staatsexamen mit überdurchschnittlichen Ergebnissen.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Aufsichtsrecht für Finanzinstitute, erworben in einer Großkanzlei, einer renommierten Boutique oder in-house bei einem regulierten Institut.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken: WpIG, WpHG, KAGB, MaRisk, MaComp und GwG.
  • Belastbare Kenntnisse in weiteren Rechtsgebieten, insbesondere Vertrags-, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht.
  • Du erfasst komplexe aufsichtsrechtliche Sachverhalte schnell, entscheidest eigenständig und begleitest die Umsetzung federführend.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du möchtest dich auf ein einzelnes Rechtsgebiet spezialisieren? Diese Rolle ist bewusst generalistisch angelegt: Neben dem aufsichtsrechtlichen Schwerpunkt liegen Vertrags-, Arbeits- und Datenschutzrecht ebenfalls bei dir.
  • Du arbeitest lieber im Kanzlei-Set-up mit Zuarbeit und mehreren Prüfschleifen? Bei uns bist du die Rechtsfunktion und triffst Entscheidungen selbst. Wir bieten dir dafür viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, unter anderem beim Aufbau einer Junior-Position an deiner Seite.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Ein reines 9-to-5-Mindset passt nicht zu dieser Rolle.


Was wir dir bieten
